name: Gunnison's prairie dog
desc: Gunnison's prairie dog (Cynomys gunnisoni): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 16 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Gunnison's prairie dog is one of five species of prairie dog. This species belongs to the squirrel family of rodents, and are predominantly related to the North American and Eurasian ground squirrels.
